policy.discriminant: record_type and payload_schema; no inferred defaults
policy.identity: project_id/logical_id/revision_id are nominal envelopes, not interchangeable strings
policy.normative_features: required, nonempty, unique; reader capabilities are external inputs
policy.numbers: JSON-safe exact integers only; larger values use {$type:exact_integer,decimal:canonical-string}
policy.missing_null_empty: distinct, never substituted by permissive defaults
policy.extensions: info.* namespace; preserved but never merged into policy
policy.compatibility: exact registered schema; semantic change requires explicit migration, not latest lookup
policy.authority: wire format, domain integrity, proof and admission are separate checks

formats.contract: decode_identity preserves project/kind/revision; no resolution or authority
axis+variant exact; no promotion or lifecycle projection
eight declaration kinds; full correspondence is separate from shape and reference existence
No mutable current_project; codecs must preserve all pinned references
No broadening grants, implicit disjointness or missing-source erasure
Purpose not task; proposed draft distinct from executable obligation
Multiple realizations may implement one capability; no file-exists completion
Independent from tests and from code; no automatic PROVED
Admission profile requires complete contracts; absent/null/empty have separate diagnostics; no completed/verified/migrated authority flags
Membership pins obligation/revision/scope; no duplicate normative authority
Normative architecture not inferred from observed imports
Only registered pure semantics; unknown kind must be reported, not skipped
APPROVED data distinct from externally established ratification
Current in-memory model exists; codec and authorized state projection are different obligations

planned_payload_policy: Descriptions freeze required semantic information, not final domain decoder implementation. Future record types are rejected by the current envelope schema, never accepted as opaque dictionaries.
status_representation_decision: Current CommitmentStatus is lifecycle; DueStatus separately preserves CURRENT/FUTURE/CONDITIONAL/OPTIONAL/RESEARCH. The B00 selection records this split; no implicit enum renaming or ratification.
